_doc: Per-type calibration applied on top of OpenAP. Edit freely; the simulator re-derives everything from these.
ld_max     : target maximum lift-to-drag ratio of the clean aircraft (wave drag excluded). The OpenAP drag polar
(CD0 and k) is scaled by one factor so that L/D max equals this value.
max_fl_mid : maximum flight level at mid weight (OEW + 0.5*(MTOW-OEW)), ISA, own cruise Mach, defined as the
highest level with >= 300 ft/min residual climb. Max climb thrust is scaled by one factor to hit it.
(The 1.3 g buffet margin and the certified ceiling still apply and can cap it lower.)
fuel_factor: optional multiplier on OpenAP fuel flow, only where its engine fuel model is clearly off.
cruise_mach: optional override of OpenAP's WRAP cruise Mach statistic; cas_schedule: optional climb/descent IAS (default VMO-30, max 300).
Values are approximate typical figures for each type, not manufacturer data.
